items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: He's about the only one I know of living.

ctx.x: Well I don't know why, but there's something about playing that type of blues, it's just hard to find.
Nobody here, the closest man. Albert was back in them days, I don't know if he played it, Albert Fernandez. He was back there. He's about the only one I know of living.
He don't play trumpet no more. Yeah, Albert Walters.
